public_rationale: Continued cash burn satisfies the operating-condition reading used here, and a subsequent large financing commitment is documented. Those facts are consistent with continued fundraising. They do not establish that multiple or record rounds were necessary, much less necessary forever. There is no deadline and no decisive event settling the full claim.
limitations: The condition is met under a continuing-cash-consumption reading; an exactly unchanged financial pace has not been established.
CNBC attributes the cash-burn figure to unnamed sources.
Committed capital is not treated as cash received.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: At its current pace, OpenAI would have to raise either multiple rounds or the largest funding round ever raised by any company, and then keep doing so in perpetuity.

statement.excerpt: Raise either multiple rounds, or the largest funding round ever raised by any company, and then have to keep doing so in perpetuity.

from_speaker: or the largest funding round ever raised by any company
our_interpretation: Current pace means continuing heavily cash-consuming operations, rather than holding every revenue and expense figure exactly constant.
Multiple rounds means distinct primary financing rounds. Employee share sales and separate installments of one round are not automatically additional rounds.
The record-sized alternative requires a defined historical comparison. The wording does not limit that comparison to US venture rounds.
The adjacent six-month prediction does not supply a deadline for the separate perpetuity clause.
Observed fundraising can corroborate a near-term pattern without proving that fundraising was necessary or will remain necessary forever.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes recurring financing necessity at the stated operating pace and the specified multiple-round or record-round pattern. A finite series can support the observed pattern but cannot establish the perpetual requirement.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive transition to durable self-financing establishes that the stated operating pace can continue without recurring external rounds.
